tables.name: users
tables.purpose: Stores user account information for authentication and task ownership

columns.name: created_at
columns.notes: Timestamp when user account was created

columns.name: updated_at
columns.notes: Timestamp when user account was last updated

tables.name: tasks
tables.purpose: Stores task information including title, description, completion status, and ownership

columns.name: user_id
columns.notes: Foreign key referencing the user who owns this task

columns.name: is_completed
columns.notes: Flag indicating whether task is completed

columns.name: completed_at
columns.notes: Timestamp when task was marked as completed

columns.name: updated_at
columns.notes: Timestamp when task was last updated

relationships.notes: Each task belongs to one user

assumptions: Each user can have multiple tasks (one-to-many relationship)
Tasks are soft-deleted or hard-deleted based on F3 requirements - schema supports hard deletion
User authentication and session management will be handled at application layer
Task filtering by status (active/completed) is supported via is_completed boolean flag
The system supports a single user role as specified in requirements
Email is used as the unique identifier for user login
Timestamps are stored in UTC and timezone conversion handled at application layer
Task completion tracking includes both a boolean flag and timestamp for audit purposes
No task priority, due date, or category fields included as not specified in requirements
No task sharing or collaboration features as only single user role exists
